title: Participating Practice Manual — Start-of-Treatment Share Outside Rider Coverage
content:
**Orthodontic Benefit Riders: start-of-treatment work done before coverage begins.** Work done before coverage begins is not covered. In the recognised covered-treatment fee, the part of the fee for the start of treatment is therefore taken off:

| Appliance on the case | Start-of-treatment share taken off |
|---|---|
| fixed braces | 15 percent of the fee |
| clear aligners | 30 percent of the fee |
| limited or interceptive, or any other case | nothing |

The appliance type is read from the case's establishment entry.

*Hypothetical figures:* on a fee of 4,620.00, the start-of-treatment share is 693.00 for fixed braces and 1,386.00 for clear aligners. A limited case has none.
